BiblicalUsage: The name is Romamti-Ezer, an Israelite. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 25:4, "…Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah…", and again in 1 Chronicles 25:31.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Romamti-Ezer matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
